subject: Request for residency carveout + commercial credit — Crescent Health
messages:
From: Sofia Martin <sofia.martin@crescenthealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: anil.rao@crescenthealth.com, procurement@crescenthealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private hosting + audit requirements for pilot — ask and pricing

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — Crescent is interested in a private deployment for our pilot. A few items came up from procurement and IT that we need to surface early so we can move fast:

- We need an on-prem / VPC-hosted instance with tenant isolation (air-gapped preferred) and HSM-backed key management.
- Crescent requires a yearly on-site audit window (up to 45 days) with the ability to pull logs, access audit artifacts, and review configuration.
- Our security team is asking for a 40% commercial concession on list pricing for a 36-month commitment to offset on-prem onboarding costs.
- Procurement also wants explicit language allowing a limited backup snapshot for disaster recovery stored within EU-only infrastructure.

I've attached our RFP Exhibit A and the security questionnaire. Can you confirm feasibility and whether Redwood can accommodate the discount and audit scope? We are hoping to get a commercial term-sheet this week.

Sofia Martin
Procurement Manager
Crescent Health Systems

--- attachment: Crescent_RFP_ExhibitA.pdf (pdf) ---

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Sofia Martin <sofia.martin@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting + audit requirements for pilot — ask and pricing

Sofia — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick acknowledgement: we can support a private/VPC deployment and HSM integration, but a few of the audit/data requests and the requested concession need internal sign-off.

Internal notes / immediate asks:
- Kimberly: legal needs to review the proposed audit mechanics and the snapshot language (particularly retention and restore process).
- Priyom: can you confirm operational impact for a 36-month on-prem commitment + HSM/backup snapshot in EU? Any add-on infra costs we should flag?
- Laura: will Ops require a runbook change or a separate SOW for the air-gapped mode?

Suggested commercial starting point for negotiation (subject to exec approval): we can offer a one-time onboarding credit and tiered concession up to 30% off list for a multiyear (36m) commitment; we are not able to immediately accept a flat 40% without exec approval.

I will coordinate a single thread for legal/ops to propose guardrails and escalate any exceptions needing VP approval. Please expect a formal reply with proposed redlines by EOD tomorrow.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
--- attachment: deal_summary_markus_20250714.pdf (pdf) ---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, Sofia Martin <sofia.martin@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting + audit requirements for pilot — legal / guardrails

Markus / Sofia — reviewed the questionnaire and the asks. High-level legal position and recommended carveouts: 

1) Audit scope: we can agree to a time-boxed audit window but recommend capping to 30 days per 12-month period (not 45 days); audits limited to operational logs, configuration, and exported telemetry necessary to validate controls. No access to Redwood source code or proprietary runtime internals. All audit activity requires prior 30-day notice and must be executed on-site or via approved third-party auditor under NDA.

2) Snapshot/backup: we can allow customer-controlled encrypted snapshots stored in EU regions, provided KMS keys are managed by the customer and HSM integration is via approved KMS connectors. Backups must be encrypted at rest and transit; restore access requires joint-runbook execution and a certified change window.

3) Commercial: legal will not approve a unilateral 40% list discount. Proposal: 25% baseline discount for 36-month committed ARR + a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to 10% of first year ARR to cover custom infra/SOW. Anything beyond requires VP-level pricing approval.

4) SLA / Support: for on-prem we need a paid SOW for ops runbooks, patching cadence, and incident response. Suggest a separate SOW line item and pass-through travel/hosting costs if on-site visits exceed 5 days per year.

If Sales/Executive team approve exceptions to the audit window and commercial upper limit we can proceed to draft redlines. Please confirm the business sponsor and if Crescent can accept the 30-day audit cap and the snapshot constraints.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: ESCALATION: Crescent Health — approval request (pricing + audit carveouts)

Team — escalating for exec approval. Crescent is a strategically important EU prospect (healthcare vertical) and expects term-sheet this week. I need a concise approval or an explicit alternative by EOD tomorrow on the following exceptions: 

A) Pricing: Approve up to 30% total commercial concession (25% baseline discount + one-time 5% onboarding credit) for a 36-month committed ARR.
B) Audit window: Approve limited exception to allow up to 30 days/year on-site audit (logs/config only) under NDA; deny any request for source-code access.
C) Snapshot & HSM: Approve customer-managed KMS/HSM integration with EU-only snapshot storage and joint restore runbook; require SOW for DR testing and incident support.
D) Operational: Approve separate SOW for on-prem operationalization and pass-through travel costs beyond 5 days/year.

If approved, Kimberly will push the redlines and I will send the commercial sheet to Crescent. If you do not approve, please provide an alternate set of concessions (e.g., lower discount, additional term, or stronger SOW requirements) that we can present.

Required approvers: VP Sales or CRO + Head of Legal (Kimberly already looped). Please reply to this thread with APPROVE or PROPOSE ADJUSTMENTS.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
